Airlines we represent

Thousand Hills Cargo Services Ltd is the cargo GSSA for Savanna Example Air and Kilimanjaro Example Cargo in Rwanda.

Savanna Example Air appointed Thousand Hills Cargo Services Ltd as its cargo GSSA in Rwanda with effect from 1 March 2026, covering belly capacity on its passenger flights to Kigali.

Passenger ticket sales for Savanna Example Air in Rwanda are handled by Lakeside Travel Agency Ltd, not by us.
